issue.title: Add test coverage for issue 36402
issue.body:
Create test coverage for issue: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/36402.

### Summary

Issue fails the Server Sent Events (SSE) while in native mode. New coverage adds app to simulate & test this behavior.
Original reproducer is [here](https://github.com/sdaschner/quarkus-playground/tree/36402-sse-native-cli).
